START_HERE.column_2: Single workbook with connected synthetic healthcare, workforce, device, logistics, resilience and service operations data.
All records are fictional. No real patient or clinician data is included.
Start with hospitals, patients, nurses, devices or shipments. Use *_id columns to join tables. Never join on names.
A unique ID identifying one row in its own table.
An ID column that points to the primary key in another table.
hospitals is the facility hub; patients, nurses, devices, shipments and alerts connect to it. Patient/device/operations tables connect through IDs.
Some shipments are hospital-wide. shipment_patient_allocation only contains patient-specific allocations; patient_id is not forced onto every shipment.
Use shipment_events, ticket_status_history and audit_log for lifecycle history. Current status columns are only the latest snapshot.
available_qty is calculated as on_hand_qty minus reserved_qty.
Timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC strings where applicable.
Synthetic approximate coordinates; not for navigation.
Open QA_validation. Every listed check should show PASS.
Open Golden_scenarios and filter scenario_id across sheets to trace each scenario.

Golden_scenarios.relationship_chain: shipment_patient_allocation.shipment_id -> logistics_shipments.shipment_id -> distribution_center_id -> distribution_centers; resilience_alerts.related_shipment_id -> shipment_id; shipment_events.shipment_id -> shipment_id
Golden_scenarios.expected_business_flow: Patient has 2 days of supply; impacted origin DC is replaced with alternate DC; shipment is rerouted and delivered.

Golden_scenarios.relationship_chain: therapy_sessions.therapy_episode_id -> therapy_episodes; nurse_patient_assignment.nurse_id -> nurses; intervention_cases.patient_id -> patients
Golden_scenarios.expected_business_flow: Missed session is recorded; old assignment is deactivated; replacement nurse assignment and completed intervention are recorded.

Golden_scenarios.relationship_chain: device_alarms.ticket_id -> service_tickets.ticket_id; service_tickets.assigned_technician_id -> technician_master; work_orders.ticket_id -> service_tickets
Golden_scenarios.expected_business_flow: Device health degrades; alarm opens a service ticket; technician closes work order after repair.

Golden_scenarios.relationship_chain: device_patient_assignment.patient_id -> patients; risk_register.patient_id -> patients; intervention_cases.patient_id -> patients; work_orders.ticket_id -> service_tickets
Golden_scenarios.expected_business_flow: Affected device is linked to a patient; critical risk and intervention are created; recall work order is closed.
Exactly 20 devices are selected and each has one execution result and audit entry.
